description: Where one sweep has got to: its status and how many of its runs have finished. This is how you answer 'is it done yet' -- read it when the person asks, not on a loop, because the engine works for minutes or hours and a second look a moment later says the same thing. Results can be read while it is still running; the rows that exist are real.

experiment_id.description: The sweep, as create_sweep returned it.
